dog.description_text:
My name is Karina, and did you know my name means “dear,” “beloved,” or “pure”? ❤️ Pretty perfect for a little girl like me!
🐶 9–10 weeks old
🐾 Potential Chihuahua Mix
💕 Tiny in size, HUGE in love!
I'm a sweet little girl who loves hanging out with my brother Greg! 🥰 We're quite the adorable duo!
I'm good with other dogs and children, and while I might be a little shy when we first meet, it doesn't take much to win me over! A little patience, some gentle affection, and before you know it, we'll be best friends! ❤️
🏡 I'm looking for a forever family who will love me, spoil me, and make me feel like the beloved little princess I am!
dog.name: Karina
